purpose: Prepare unit-aware formulas for later actual acceptance usage; no production acceptance or actual bill conclusion.

accountSnapshot.counterBoundary: Product view and usage_summary are separate returned views. Do not add or silently substitute them; neither gives attributable per-case usage.

productViewArithmeticHeadroom.meaning: Snapshot arithmetic only, not reserved case quota or a guarantee of later availability.

scopedDailyQuery.meaning: Empty result is absent scoped data, not proof of zero usage or invoice.

accountSnapshot.retentionAddonInterpretation: A stored tier supplies USD 0.00005 per ingested MB (USD 0.05 per decimal GB). Addon subscribed=false and currentUsage=0. Its nested tier current_amount_usd=0.00 does not replace null base or total monetary values.

publicRateCards.priceBasis: Public usage-based list prices; not an observed invoice, a negotiated account quote, taxes, or proof of the final account charge.

logs.customRetentionBoundary: Additional to ingestion. Retention applies to newly ingested logs and the ingestion billing limit does not cap custom-retention charges.

aiObservability.boundary: AI generations/spans/traces captured as AI events are event-billed; no PostHog markup on provider tokens. Do not treat each OTLP APM span as an AI event or assume one event per model call.

webReplay.boundary: Use actual billable Web recordings, not screenshots, replay frames, playback reads, or an assumed one-recording-per-case count. Mobile replay is a separate meter and is outside this browser-case formula.

organizationBilling.quotaScope: Organization-wide across projects, not an extra free allowance per project.
organizationBilling.limitBehavior: At the configured limit, extra data may be permanently dropped. A free allowance is not a promise that all later telemetry will be retained.
organizationBilling.historicalConflict: Current Logs pricing and this account snapshot both say 10 GB free. An older 50 GB GA announcement is not used.

apmTracing.established: Usage-based with no per-host fee; accepts OpenTelemetry and is correlated with Logs.
apmTracing.unknownReason: The inspected account has no separate APM product rate. The inspected official tracing page does not establish a numeric PostHog span-ingestion rate or prove that all trace volume is included in logs_mb_ingested.
apmTracing.treatment: Keep APM-specific ingestion costs UNKNOWN unless an actual billing contract/meter mapping provides evidence. Do not silently count it twice or set it to zero.

scoutAndVision.treatment: Current raw unit prices and amounts are null. Credit/display metadata is not a verified cost per Scout or Vision execution. No additional pricing investigation or execution was performed.

formulas.tierFunction: For nonnegative U, F_p(U)=sum_i rate_i * max(0,min(U,upper_i)-lower_i), with infinity for a null upper bound.
formulas.incrementalCharge: For a verified same-period organization baseline B_p and attributable increment x_p: Delta_p=F_p(B_p+x_p)-F_p(B_p).
formulas.customRetention: Additional public-price term = 0.05 * actual billable retained GB-months. Do not subtract the default 14 days without a contract for that proration.
formulas.indicativeKnownIngestionRange: For nonnegative measured x_MB, E and R: 0 <= Delta_known <= 0.25*(x_MB/1000)+0.000350*E+0.005*R; excludes retention, APM-unknown mapping, Scout/Vision, account-specific adjustments and tax.
formulas.conditionalFreeTier: If total organization usage, including concurrent traffic, remains within the verified free allowances and default retention applies, these three public-price ingestion terms are zero. This does not turn null observed monetary amounts into a verified zero invoice.
formulas.baselineBoundary: The recorded 492 MB / 1222 events / 22 recordings is the product-view preacceptance snapshot only. Billing delay and concurrent unrelated traffic prevent attributing a later aggregate difference to these cases alone.
formulas.volumeBoundary: Span/event row counts, sample-rate-weighted traffic estimates, serialized JSON size and compressed OTLP transfer bytes are not automatically billable ingestion MB.
formulas.modelProviderBoundary: PostHog AI event fees are distinct from provider token value. An API-equivalent token-cost estimate is not the actual Claude/Codex official subscription charge.
formulas.totalActualCostStatus: UNKNOWN; no finite numerical total or predicted future two-case volume is claimed.

laterEvidenceNeeded: Actual two-case identities/time windows and complete evidence before computing attributable usage.
Actual billable meter units and values; preserve physical counts and unknowns rather than replacing missing units with zero.
Current same-period organization baseline and quota usage if evaluating the incremental public-price calculation.
Separate original billing amount evidence if claiming an actual invoice or subscription charge.

operationBoundary.evidenceAction: One unreferenced safe JSON Git blob plus exact readback; no branch/ref update.

conclusion: Prepared unit-aware public-rate formulas and unknown boundaries only. Production acceptance remains 0/2; no performance, telemetry completeness, subscription invoice, or final production PASS is inferred.
